# EDA interpretations (auto-generated from run)

- Imbalance: Credit reporting or other personal consumer reports is 51.3% of rows and Debt or credit management only 0.46% (ratio 111.1:1; normalised entropy 0.68). A stratified-random guesser gets accuracy ~0.31 but Macro F1 only ~0.091 (=1/K), which is why Macro F1 is the primary metric.
- Duplicates: 50.6% of the 276,275 cleaned narratives are exact copies of another narrative (after masking); grouping (exact + near-duplicate) removes 64.7% of rows (38,910 caught only by the near-duplicate rule), leaving 97,655 distinct complaints. The largest group is one template letter repeated 7,788 times; 345 groups had the same text under different products.
- Leakage: 0 groups and 0 identical normalised texts are shared across splits. Residual near-duplicates: 22.0% of 2,000 sampled val/test rows have a train row with cosine >= 0.8 (median best match 0.40).
- Split balance: chi-square(20) = 0.07, p = 1.000; largest class-proportion deviation from the full data is 0.01 percentage points, so the splits preserve the class mix.
- Top terms (train only, mean TF-IDF): Checking or savings account: account, bank, money, funds, check; Credit card: card, credit, account, payment, bank; Credit reporting or other personal consumer reports: report, credit, reporting, information, account; Debt collection: debt, collection, credit, company, account; Debt or credit management: debt, company, credit, account, paid; Money transfer, virtual currency, or money service: money, account, bank, transfer, funds; Mortgage: mortgage, loan, payment, escrow, home; Payday loan, title loan, personal loan, or advance loan: loan, payment, payments, company, paid; Prepaid card: card, gift, use, money, cards; Student loan: loans, loan, student, mohela, navient; Vehicle loan or lease: car, vehicle, loan, payment, payments
